# Maali Platform

> Maali is Africa's opportunity hub — discover grants, jobs, internships, trainings, scholarships, and fellowships, apply with confidence, and track outcomes.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the Maali opportunity platform for African talent.
- [Opportunities](/opportunities): Browse all open grants, jobs, scholarships, fellowships, and trainings.
- [About](/about): Mission, values, and how Maali supports African entrepreneurs and talent.
- [Resources](/resources): Guides, templates, and toolkits for applicants.
- [Partners](/partners): Funding and ecosystem partners working with Maali.
- [Success Stories](/success-stories): Real outcomes from people who used Maali.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles on funding, careers, and entrepreneurship across Africa.
- [Mentors](/mentors): Mentors available to guide applicants and founders.
- [FAQ](/faq): Common questions about applications, eligibility, and fees.
- [Help](/help): Support center for using the platform.
- [Guide](/guide): Step-by-step guide to getting started on Maali.
- [Contact](/contact): Reach the Maali team.
